name: sun
note: The sunburst breaking through cloud. Brightest point of the painting and the implied light source for every other effect.

name: reflection
note: Golden reflection column running down the water to the bottom edge. The glitter path.

name: clouds-bright
note: Pale billowing cloud, upper right. Already bright, so added light does least here.

name: clouds-dark
note: Dark storm mass, upper left. Good target for lightning and cold light.

name: water
note: Sea surface below the horizon. Horizontal ripple band.

name: horizon
note: Sky/water division, around y=0.54. Effect bands should respect it — a ripple that crosses it breaks the illusion instantly.
